WE ARE BACK!!

🌟Favorite The Game To Help Us Out!
🔔Click the bell to be notified when a new update drops!
👍NEW UPDATE AT 10K LIKES! LIKE THE GAME NOW!

Jump into containers with liquids and enjoy physics!

This game is inspired by the game Quicksand that used to exist not too long ago.

🎥 If you are a Content Creator & you make a video on the game, please put the game link somewhere. This helps the game grow.
🎥 If you plan/already make videos on the game often, you can reach out to me and you will be given perks. The perks given depend on the popularity of your channel.
